1095 W MCKINLEY · PROPOSED REMODEL

Explore the space.

Four bedrooms, three full bathrooms and open living spaces. The revised design features vaulted front bedrooms, a tall canted bay, a high entry window, a black-framed kitchen window over walnut and quartz cabinetry, and a black fluted feature wall in the shared bathroom.

Previous layout refinements

  1. Shared bathroom: toilet tank against the west wall, bowl facing across the room.
  2. Bedroom 3: compact step-in closet; Bedroom 4: separate 24-inch-deep reach-in with bypass doors.
  3. Primary dressing: internal partitions and short bedroom doorway returns removed; fitted wardrobes keep the passage clear.
  4. Primary bathroom: 60 × 42-inch shower, floating double vanity, low linen storage and a privacy door.

Explore 27 path-traced 360° views of the modern design: late-morning daylight, white oak floors, walnut and Calacatta quartz, soft fabrics and garden outlooks. Select Play tour to follow the connected route, or Browse scenes to jump to a room. Every view is rendered from the measured model, and the 3D Walk, Dollhouse and Floor plan show the same model with its lighting baked in; use Dimensions for exact measurements. Furnishings, decor and landscaping are illustrative staging.

Presentation inspiration: Matterport’s published Palo Alto home tour. This independent remodel concept is not a captured scan of the property.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

Tour settings

Exterior shows the complete house and roof: drag to orbit, use Front / Rear / Left side / Right side / Roof, or scroll and pinch to zoom. Hide garden reveals walls behind landscaping. Drag to orbit in dollhouse. In Walk mode, drag to look and click floor rings to move. You can also use W/A/S/D, arrow keys or the on-screen arrows. Scroll zooms the view. In Styled tour, W or Up moves to the next connected viewpoint you face; Left/Right looks around. Choose 3D Walk for continuous movement in the furnished model. Furnishing and shadow controls affect the 3D model only.
